title: Volta
description: A wordless poet who shows up every day: one plain human throat scats a fourteen-line sonnet over a drummer who cannot stop talking, a dead typewriter takes dictation in every gap, and at the turn the room goes quiet except for glass that changes the light.

sections.development: the ask, spoken and nearly naked: a voice and a drummer who will not stop talking
the same lines; a dead typewriter takes dictation in the voice's rests, and the octave leans forward
the turn: the drummer is cut off mid-sentence and the glass changes the light to F
the same lines, said with more breath; the glass settles on D, not home, and the last question is hummed
